title: card type cezi
description: Mechanical skeleton of a 'cezi' card (docs/cards/CARDS_INTERFACES.md section 4). Player-facing text lives in data/cards/text/** (human only).

id.description: Card id, regex ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\.[a-z0-9_]+)+$, first segment fixed by type (section 4.2)

era.description: Eras the card exists in: ['1938'], ['1938','1939'] or ['*']

weight.description: Base weight in its pool; 0 = never drawn at random, only by schedule/effects

gold.description: Gold story card (section 10); only person with story_node

keepable.description: Can be kept in hand zone 'kept' (kept type always true, gold always false)

expires_days.description: Days after keeping until it expires; 0 = never

must_resolve.description: Must be handled before closing the shop (defaults per type)

conditions.description: Condition (section 5.3) for entering the pool / being dealt

brief.description: Designer note; never shipped (stripped by stage_ship.py)
